title: Incentivize Contribution and Learn Parameters Too: Federated Learning with Strategic Data Owners
abstract: arXiv:2505.12010v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In federated learning (FL), a center trains a shared model from updates that clients compute on their private data. Collecting and training on data is costly, so a strategic client may contribute little data and free-ride on the model trained by the others. We study mechanisms that incentivize data contribution and learn the model at the same time. Our first mechanism, UPBReD, updates the clients ' contributions and the model jointly, and converges at a geometric rate to a Nash equilibrium of the contribution game together with the welfare-maximizing model for those contributions. This equilibrium can involve under-contribution, so our second mechanism, 2P-UPBReD, adds budget-balanced transfers that make full contribution a dominant strategy, after which training converges to the optimal model; we also give conditions under which every client prefers to participate. translated_title: 激励贡献并同时学习参数：面向策略性数据拥有者的联邦学习
translated_abstract: 在联邦学习（FL）中，一个中心根据客户端在其私有数据上计算得到的更新来训练一个共享模型。收集数据并在其上进行训练是有代价的，因此策略性的客户端可能只贡献很少的数据，从而搭其他人训练成果的便车。我们研究了能够同时激励数据贡献并学习模型的机制。我们的第一个机制 UPBReD 联合更新客户端的贡献和模型，并以几何速率收敛到贡献博弈的纳什均衡，同时得到针对这些贡献的福利最大化模型。由于该均衡可能存在贡献不足的问题，我们的第二个机制 2P-UPBReD 引入了预算平衡的转移支付，使完全贡献成为占优策略，此后训练即收敛到最优模型；我们还给出了每个客户端都愿意参与的条件。两种机制都信任客户端对其所贡献数据的报告。
tldr: 提出两种联邦学习机制：UPBReD 以几何速率联合收敛到贡献博弈的纳什均衡与福利最大化模型，而 2P-UPBReD 通过预算平衡的转移支付使完全贡献成为客户端的占优策略，从而实现最优模型训练。
en_tdlr: Proposes two federated learning mechanisms—UPBReD, which converges at a geometric rate to a Nash equilibrium of the contribution game with a welfare-maximizing model, and 2P-UPBReD, which adds budget-balanced transfers making full contribution a dominant strategy so that training converges to the optimal model.
